name: Graphmarks-inspired living graph
statement: Users can accomplish graphmarks-inspired living graph while preserving user-owned meaning, usability and consent.
requiredProperties: Clickable typed node circles for websites, bookmarks, notes, galleries, documents, tags, files, R2 and local resources
Nodes open bookmark or inspector and can expand annotated relations and clusters
Node radius optionally based on visit count, measured active dwell, normalized weighted combination or uniform
Never conflate tab-open time or idle background time with real active browsing; show uncertainty
Graph modes: visited-site, curated semantics, provider resources, hybrid
Search, time filters, clustered layouts, keyboard list fallback and efficient large-set rendering
Right inspector supports pinned local-top / R2-bottom split preview
